title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 01/2012
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Warm matrix recording with deep drum presence captures a patient, inspiring second set.
ai_review.review: The recording offers a pleasantly reverberant soundstage – the snares are unusually deep and the overall mix has added warmth despite a slightly thin vocal texture.  Listeners rave about the second‑set performance, noting its patience, inspiration and solid flow, making this a standout show for the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews consistently praise the musical performance (especially the second set) and describe the sound as warm and well‑balanced, with only minor critiques about front‑end clarity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Two‑audience matrix mix gives extra depth to drums (snare richness) and a roomy reverb that adds warmth; vocals are a bit thin/tinny and the mix is not as upfront as some listeners prefer, but overall pleasant.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set shines with patient pacing and inspired playing; the whole concert is regarded as a solid, kick‑ass performance.

band_member_comments.Drums: Snares have notable depth and presence, praised by multiple reviewers.
